children.game_version: Focus on mimicking nature-themed gestures like butterflies.

seniors.counts: Simplified counts to match a slower drum beat.
seniors.seated_version: Perform hip and arm movements while seated in a sturdy chair.
seniors.standing_version: Perform movements with support from a barre or chair.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and smaller range of motion for hips.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Gestural movements that are abstract but thematic

signature_moves.description: Rapid hip-shaking motion performed by women.
signature_moves.name: fa'arapu

signature_moves.description: Scissor-like leg movement performed by men.
signature_moves.name: pa'oti

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Fast, percussive, synchronized with hip movements
music_profile.sound_description: A rapid, driving sound produced by wooden slit drums and skin-covered drums, characterized by complex, interlocking rhythmic patterns without melodic accompaniment.

teaching.level_notes: Requires high physical stamina for rapid hip-shaking and leg coordination.
